scope: Precise coordinates and indexed topology across component Keep, Remove, Flip and Extract; not a native-equivalence claim.
regression: Component edits rounded wider source coordinates to Float32 and did not publish their matching indexed topology.
implementation: Preserve non-Float32 corner values, compact matching source or cached topology by source vertex identity, and publish per-output indices. If cached welded representatives differ from raw corners, leave the result unindexed instead of changing those corners.

validation.focused: 102 tests passed, including coincident indexed components with and without a prewarmed cache; guarded job cleaned up.
validation.browser: On a manufactured indexed three-component model with wider coordinates, GUI and public MCP matched exact corners and indexed vertices/triangles for Keep, Flip, Extract and two removal modes. Undo/redo, binary save/reopen, cancellation and source visibility passed.

largeScanInvestigation.input: Original ply-3, 3,691,133 faces; GUI finite Split followed by public-MCP component Flip in a cross-origin-isolated browser.
largeScanInvestigation.baseline: The component request failed while cloning worker input. The guarded job peaked at 4,834,553,856 bytes and cleaned up.
largeScanInvestigation.inputTransportPrototype: A private transferable Float64 input prototype passed 90 focused tests and removed the original clone error, but the large replay still failed under the 4 GiB limit. An instrumented retry reached topology completion before the browser command timed out; both prototype runs cleaned up.
largeScanInvestigation.finalCandidate: Compact edge-connected component grouping, bounded typed face/index buffers, private transferable coordinates, and worker-side display preparation replaced the full adjacency graph and repeated full-size cloning.
largeScanInvestigation.finalResult: Public-MCP Flip completed after GUI Split, preserved the cutter and indexed output, and passed Undo/Redo. The 3,691,133-face original became 3,700,757 faces after Split; peak aggregate job use was 4,022,763,520 bytes, below the 4,294,967,296-byte cap. Processes and ports cleaned up.
largeScanInvestigation.focused: 118 tests passed, including compact/full grouping comparisons, aliasing, empty removal and packed transport failure cleanup.

largeExtract.scope: GUI Split followed by public-MCP Extract of one component from the original ply-3 scan in a cross-origin-isolated browser.
largeExtract.baseline: Before transferable segment input/output, Extract failed cloning worker input and the aggregate peak was 4,538,220,544 bytes.
largeExtract.result: An indexed 1,779,171-face component was created from the 3,700,757-face Split result; source and cutter digests and Undo/Redo passed. Peak aggregate job use was 3,912,290,304 bytes under the 4,294,967,296-byte limit, with clean process and port cleanup.
largeExtract.focused: 123 tests passed, including packed Extract input, multi-segment output, aliasing, malformed responses and worker cleanup.

limitations: Native component output and indexed seam identity were not independently observed in this control.
The large original-scan checks cover public-MCP Flip and one Extract after GUI Split, not GUI component execution, persistence, non-isolated mode or a native comparison.
Other M2 acceptance gates remain open.
